title: requirements.txt omits pytest despite README documenting pytest test command
evidence: requirements.txt contains only 'flask'; README.md:39 instructs 'python -m pytest test_app.py -v' but pytest is not declared
suggestion: Add pytest to requirements.txt (or a requirements-dev.txt)

title: Tests operate on the real books.db rather than an isolated test database
evidence: test_app.py:19 sqlite3.connect('books.db') and setUp DELETEs all rows — same DB file app.py:9 uses in production
suggestion: Point tests at a temp/in-memory SQLite DB so a test run cannot wipe real data

title: 404 responses returned via abort() emit HTML, not JSON
evidence: app.py:99,115,164 call abort(404); Flask's default 404 body is HTML while spec R8 asks for JSON responses
suggestion: Register a JSON 404 error handler for full JSON consistency
